svg.aria-label: Thor CAN breakout: Protected CAN breakout boards and printed housings for NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor, in KiCad and CadQuery.
svg.title: Thor CAN breakout: Protected CAN breakout boards and printed housings for NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor, in KiCad and CadQuery.
svg.desc: The two-port board drawn from its KiCad layout: the outline is traced, pads and copper settle, the J47 header and both DE9 ports drop on, the CAN0 and CAN1 pairs are laid from the header to their ports, and pulses run along each pair, high and low in step. Drawn from mvalancy/pcb-agx-thor-can-breakout at commit b829d3104c40.
